draft.subject: Your question on downgrade timing
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for your question about downgrade timing -- your ticket is still open and a colleague is following up with you directly on that, so you'll hear back there.

In the meantime, I don't want setup to stall while you wait. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in place usually makes everything else click. If it's useful, I can walk you through that first project on a short call this week -- just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Priya
